title: CareerPath AI Aptitude & Technical Competency Diagnostic

questions.question: Which data structure follows the First-In, First-Out (FIFO) principle?
questions.explanation: Queues process elements in the order they arrive (First In First Out).

questions.question: In SQL, which clause is used to filter records AFTER an aggregation operation (GROUP BY)?
questions.explanation: HAVING filters aggregate values, whereas WHERE filters individual rows prior to aggregation.

questions.question: If a train traveling at 60 km/h crosses a 200m platform in 24 seconds, what is the length of the train?
questions.explanation: Speed = 60 * (5/18) = 50/3 m/s. Total distance = speed * time = (50/3)*24 = 400m. Train length = 400 - 200 = 200m.

questions.question: What is the primary objective of Supervised Machine Learning?
options: Predicting target outcomes using labeled training pairs
questions.explanation: Supervised learning trains models on labeled input-output pairs to learn a mapping function.

questions.question: Choose the sentence with correct grammatical structure and professional clarity:
options: Me and him completed the project code yesterday.
Neither the team lead nor the developers were aware of the server outage.
The project was finish on time by our team.
We should of tested the production build earlier.
questions.explanation: Choice 2 correctly uses subject-verb agreement with "neither/nor".

questions.question: In a software team, if a critical bug is discovered 2 hours before release, what is the best initial approach?
options: Ignore the bug and release on schedule
Triage the bug severity with the engineering lead, document impact, and communicate options to stakeholders
Blame the developer who wrote the feature
questions.explanation: Systematic triage and transparent stakeholder communication is standard engineering practice.

questions.question: What does the time complexity O(log N) represent in Binary Search?
options: Logarithmic reduction of search space by half each iteration
questions.explanation: Binary Search halves the search space at each step, yielding logarithmic logarithmic complexity.
